{{Top|leg}}
'''Indig''', short for "indigenous", was a slang term that was meant to indicate a member of the native population of any given [[Planet/Legends|planet]], whether of an immigrated [[Species/Legends|species]] or otherwise. It was typically used by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] or others who were either visiting or occupying a planet; the term was often used by [[Valin Horn|Hal Horn]] and his son, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran]].
